description: This file defines the CRNetworkManager class responsible for managing network requests, responses, and related events within Chromium-based browser automation. It handles request interception, response processing, error handling, and session management for network activities in the context of Playwright.

classes.name: CRNetworkManager
classes.description: Manages network sessions, request interception, response handling, and event subscriptions for Chromium network activities.

classes.name: InterceptableRequest
classes.description: Represents an intercepted network request, encapsulating request details and associated session information.

classes.name: RouteImpl
classes.description: Implements network route handling, allowing request continuation, fulfillment, or failure during interception.

classes.name: ResponseExtraInfoTracker
classes.description: Tracks and associates extra response information with network responses, ensuring headers are correctly aligned.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Adds a new network session, sets up event listeners, and initializes network state.

methods.name: removeSession
methods.description: Removes a network session and cleans up associated event listeners.

methods.name: _forEachSession
methods.description: Executes a callback for each active session, handling session errors gracefully.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Sets credentials for authentication and updates request interception accordingly.

methods.name: setOffline
methods.description: Enables or disables offline mode for all sessions.

methods.name: setRequestInterception
methods.description: Enables or disables request interception globally.

methods.name: _updateProtocolRequestInterception
methods.description: Updates request interception state across all sessions based on current settings.

methods.name: _updateProtocolRequestInterceptionForSession
methods.description: Configures request interception for a specific session.

methods.name: setExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets additional HTTP headers for all sessions.

methods.name: _setExtraHTTPHeadersForSession
methods.description: Applies extra HTTP headers to a specific session.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears browser cache and disables cache temporarily.

methods.name: _onRequestWillBeSent
methods.description: Handles the event when a request is about to be sent, managing interception and request tracking.

methods.name: _onRequestServedFromCache
methods.description: Handles requests served from cache.

methods.name: _onRequestWillBeSentExtraInfo
methods.description: Processes extra info for requestWillBeSent events.

methods.name: _onAuthRequired
methods.description: Handles authentication challenges during requests.

methods.name: _shouldProvideCredentials
methods.description: Determines if credentials should be provided for a given URL.

methods.name: _onRequestPaused
methods.description: Handles paused requests during interception, deciding whether to continue, fulfill, or abort.

methods.name: _onRequest
methods.description: Processes request events, including redirects and request creation.

methods.name: _createResponse
methods.description: Constructs a network response object from response payloads, including body and timing.

methods.name: _deleteRequest
methods.description: Removes a request from tracking maps.

methods.name: _handleRequestRedirect
methods.description: Handles request redirects by creating responses and updating request state.

methods.name: _onResponseReceivedExtraInfo
methods.description: Processes extra info for responseReceived events.

methods.name: _onResponseReceived
methods.description: Handles response reception, creating response objects and associating them with requests.

methods.name: _onLoadingFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of network requests, finalizing response data.

methods.name: _onLoadingFailed
methods.description: Handles failed network requests, updating request and response states.

methods.name: _maybeUpdateRequestSession
methods.description: Updates the session associated with a request if it has migrated across sessions.
